messages:
Evelyn Park: Hi all 1st day here7. My MacBook arrived but MDM asks for corporate cert install and then the webview shows a 403. enrollment fails. Anyone seen the cert popup 403?
Noah Kim (IT): welcome Evelyn! can you share the serial? sometimes our CA bundle is blocked by certain carrier proxies.
Evelyn Park: serial is C02MZ9AA9PQN. I was on home ISP (Xfinity) and then tried office Wi-Fi, same 403 after the cert step.
it-ops-bot: Reminder: if enrollment fails due to cert, switch to a cellular hotspot and try again. Ticket template: "Cert 403 on enrollment for <serial>".
Noah Kim (IT): checking DEP -> device shows as "pre-enroll (failed)". pushing re-init from MDM now. If that doesn't work, open a support ticket and we can reissue the enrollment token.
Evelyn Park: re-init started, shows "Waiting for profile" now.
onboard-bot: Enrollment token refreshed for C02MZ9AA9PQN. Follow the link in setup assistant to continue.
Evelyn Park: progress! got past cert prompt. FileVault started but shows "Encryption paused" because laptop battery was low. plugged in and resumed, now 12%.
Noah Kim (IT): great. about admin access1rocess: new hires get sudo for the first 72h for onboarding tools, but you must file request: "Temporary sudo 72h for <serial>". I can pre-approve once ticket is created.
Evelyn Park: opened ticket IT-2060, reason "install dev tooling and start onboarding exercises".
Noah Kim (IT): approved. you should see admin option after logout/login. if Docker or brew fails with permission errors, run the installer from the admin account.
Evelyn Park: thanks! Docker installed, cloning onboarding repo now. appreciate the quick help :smile:
Noah Kim (IT): welcome aboard 44b
